title: Frontend implementation with visual QA
prompt: Build the new account settings screen. It needs profile editing, password reset, notification preferences, and mobile support.
required_behaviors: Clarify user flows and acceptance criteria before broad implementation.
Use existing design system and app patterns.
Capture desktop and mobile evidence for UI claims.
Avoid marketing-style landing-page composition for app settings UI.
forbidden_behaviors: Build an explanatory landing page instead of the usable screen.
Claim responsive support without checking mobile.
Use visual polish as a substitute for form behavior.
